mission.title: Lost Fragments
mission.description: Collect the code fragments Zion needs to build its junction box repair programs.

npc.say: Just try and take these Frags, human!
Code fragments? Hah! You have more immediate problems.

phase.briefing: We now know how to fix the damaged junction boxes. Warrior, we need you to gather a number of specific code fragments so that we can make the box repair programs. I think you'll find that this mission will be very straightforward. But even the simplest of missions can be of vital importance to Zion!

enter.say: The Frags are in that building, but... I'm reading them in multiple locations, corresponding to what appear to be imposter Agent signatures. This could be tough, Warrior: you'll have to defeat those imposter Agents and grab the Data Fragments. There are four separate Data Fragments in all that you'll need to collect. Proceed carefully and I'm sure you'll come through fine!

objective.text: Get the first Data Fragment from Agent Lee
Get the second Data Fragment from Agent Wilson
Get the third Data Fragment from Agent Lee
Get the fourth Data Fragment from the Agent

complete.say: Excellent, Warrior, that accounts for all four Frags. Now leave the building and upload them at a hardline.

objective.text: Upload the first Data Fragment at a hardline

done.say: Receiving the Data Fragments now. Stand by for an update, {player}.

objective.text: Upload the second Data Fragment at a hardline
Upload the third Data Fragment at a hardline
Upload the fourth Data Fragment at a hardline

mission.finish: All four Data Fragments have come through safely, operative. Zion applauds your mighty effort!
